info.name: LLM Studio - Multi-model
info.description: OpenAI-compatible, API-key-protected requests for the VPN-only LLM Studio service.

exec: pm.test('Trace identity headers are present', () => { ['X-Session-ID', 'X-Correlation-ID', 'X-Trace-ID', 'X-Span-ID', 'X-Execution-ID', 'traceparent'].forEach(name => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get(name), name).to.be.ok); });

pm.test('OpenAI response shape is valid', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.object).to.eql('chat.completion'); pm.expect(b.choices[0].message.role).to.eql('assistant'); pm.expect(b.usage.total_tokens).to.be.a('number'); });

pm.test('End-to-end token telemetry is present', () => { ['X-First-Token-Ms', 'X-Last-Token-Ms', 'X-Input-Tokens', 'X-Output-Tokens', 'X-Cache-Hit-Percent', 'Server-Timing'].forEach(name => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get(name), name).to.be.ok); });

pm.test('Header token counts match usage', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Number(pm.response.headers.get('X-Input-Tokens'))).to.eql(b.usage.prompt_tokens); pm.expect(Number(pm.response.headers.get('X-Output-Tokens'))).to.eql(b.usage.completion_tokens); });
pm.test('First token does not occur after last token', () => pm.expect(Number(pm.response.headers.get('X-First-Token-Ms'))).to.be.at.most(Number(pm.response.headers.get('X-Last-Token-Ms'))));

pm.test('Queued coding-agent requests all succeed', () => pm.expect(results.every(r => r.status === 200)).to.eql(true));
pm.test('Every request eventually runs', () => pm.expect(results.filter(r => r.status === 200)).to.have.length(count));

pm.test('Batch shares session, correlation, and trace IDs', () => { pm.expect(new Set(results.map(r => r.sessionId))).to.have.property('size', 1); pm.expect(results[0].sessionId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('concurrentSessionId')); pm.expect(new Set(results.map(r => r.correlationId))).to.have.property('size', 1); pm.expect(new Set(results.map(r => r.traceId))).to.have.property('size', 1); });

pm.test('Every execution, span, and request ID is unique', () => { ['executionId', 'spanId', 'requestId'].forEach(field => pm.expect(new Set(results.map(r => r[field])).size, field).to.eql(count)); });

pm.test('Every result has token timing, cache, counts, and Server-Timing', () => pm.expect(results.every(r => Number.isFinite(r.firstTokenMs) && Number.isFinite(r.lastTokenMs) && r.firstTokenMs <= r.lastTokenMs && Number.isFinite(r.cacheHitPercent) && Number.isFinite(r.inputTokens) && Number.isFinite(r.outputTokens) && r.serverTiming.includes('first-token'))).to.eql(true));

item.name: KV Cache
item.description: Verifies generation KV caching for Transformers models and cross-request prompt/KV caching for GGUF models.

request.description: Confirms that server-side, per-generation KV caching is enabled. Repeating the request does not reuse a cache from an earlier HTTP call.

exec: pm.test('First/last token latency is reported', () => { const first = Number(pm.response.headers.get('X-First-Token-Ms')); const last = Number(pm.response.headers.get('X-Last-Token-Ms')); pm.expect(first).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(last).to.be.at.least(first); });
